title: Mavy Legaspi says he’s ‘not in a good place mentally’ before ‘PBB’ hosting exit
summary: Mavy Legaspi said he was not in a good place mentally before taking a break from work, that’s why he requested a hiatus from his management before the “Pinoy Big Brother Celebrity Collab…

blocks.text: Mavy Legaspi said he was not in a good place mentally before taking a break from work, that’s why he requested a hiatus from his management before the “Pinoy Big Brother Celebrity Collab Edition 3.0” The actor-host made the statement during an ambush interview at the red carpet premiere of GMA Pictures’ satirical film “Red Crown” on Monday, Oct. 26, where he showed support for his girlfriend, actress Ashley Ortega, who is part of the film’s lead cast. Asked if he missed hosting “PBB” following the launch of its new season, Legaspi said he was grateful to his former co-hosts but […]...
